_comment: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. The whole `ruff --select F,W605` surface over app/ is at zero
(605 findings -> 0), so every rule is enforced by ZERO_TOLERANCE in
scripts/check_ruff_gate.py and nothing needs a ceiling.
This file is the escape hatch, not the norm: if a rule is ever added that has
existing debt, record its count here so the gate can ratchet it down instead of
being switched off. A count may FALL, never rise. Do not raise a number to make
a build pass, and do not move a rule out of ZERO_TOLERANCE into here.
With this empty, main()'s new-rule check means ANY finding fails the build,
including from a rule nobody has classified yet.
